ItemID: unavailable; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Expressive singing appeals to me, but I would prioritize stage songs this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Chicago Only The Beginning; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not seeking a broad rock collection during this visit.
